title: aim *ist
script:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ShootEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("ShootProjectileRemoteEvent")

local mobsFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("Mobs"):WaitForChild("MobCamp")
local function shootAtTarget(target)
	if not target:IsA("BasePart") then return end

	local char = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character or game.Players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	local origin = root.Position
	local direction = (target.Position - origin).Unit

	local args = {
		target, 
		origin,
		direction
	}

	ShootEvent:FireServer(unpack(args))
end

for _, mobModel in ipairs(mobsFolder:GetDescendants()) do
	if mobModel:IsA("Model") then
		local dragon = mobModel:FindFirstChild("Dragon") or mobModel:FindFirstChild("Root")
		if dragon and dragon:IsA("BasePart") then
			shootAtTarget(dragon)
		end
	end
end
